pipeline: five-seed raw CNN60% + causal SleepTransformer40% + causal hierarchical stage decoder

startup.reason: Initialize every SOS section with scipy.signal.sosfilt_zi scaled by the first raw sample, then fill one causal 30-second model window.

compatibility_validation.limitation: No doctor-labeled startup NREM or REM window is available.

preprocessing.filter: fourth-order causal Butterworth with persistent SOS state initialized as sosfilt_zi * first_sample
preprocessing.cnn: per-window per-channel EEG standardization clipped to [-8,8], plus standardized acceleration magnitude
preprocessing.sleeptransformer: four-channel causal 2 s log-power frames with 1 s hop; current and seven past windows spaced 30 s apart

sleeptransformer_frozen_feature_compatib.spectral_token_storage: float16 round-trip, then float32 ONNX input
sleeptransformer_frozen_feature_compatib.auxiliary_eeg_amplitude: historical checkpoint convention: computed from the normalized temporary spectral batch
sleeptransformer_frozen_feature_compatib.rolling_buffer_mutation: prohibited; feature extraction must operate on a copy

seed_ensemble: arithmetic mean of five three-class probability vectors

stream_context.reason: 5-second decisions need six independent phase histories so every Transformer context remains exactly 30 seconds apart

cold_restart_music.new_cold_specific_controller: rejected because outer wake-event protection was below 0.80

outputs.stage_decoder_prediction3: strictly causal W/sleep then NREM/REM hysteresis output
outputs.recovery_stage_prediction3: context-completeness-gated secondary output after unrecoverable state loss
outputs.recovery_low_confidence: true until eight 30-second-spaced contexts are available
outputs.autonomous_music_allowed: false after unrecoverable state loss until the current phase has eight valid contexts

state_reset: sensor interruption longer than the accepted gap

persist: six 5-second phases, each with eight 30-second-spaced SleepTransformer token and auxiliary contexts
standard and recovery stage decoder EMA and counters
music controller EMA, state, and counters
state_persistence.ordinary_app_backgrounding: restore state; do not cold reset
state_persistence.unrecoverable_state_loss: enter cold_restart_recovery_stage, preserve last music state when available, and prohibit autonomous switching until policy validation

reference_runtime.input: each call receives exactly five new seconds

validation_warning: Six-subject research pilot. Prospective synchronized PSG validation is required.
selected_algorithm: five-seed raw EEG CNN 60% + causal SleepTransformer 40% + causal hierarchical W/sleep then NREM/REM decoder

selection_metric.protocol: six-subject nested LOSO, five seeds, subject-equal
